meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: 4-phase systematic debugging methodology with root cause analysis and evidence-based verification. Use when debugging complex issues.

copy.tagline: 按四阶段流程排查复杂故障,验证根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在面对难以复现的复杂 bug,需要一套可循的排查方法。
copy.tagline_en: Debug complex issues with a structured 4-phase method
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug and need a systematic way to find the root cause.

howto.what: Claude 会按四个阶段帮你调试：先复现问题，再逐步缩小范围，用 5 Whys 找到根因，最后验证修复并检查是否引入新问题。
howto.when: 当你请它调试复杂问题时触发。

say.text: 请用四阶段调试法排查这个 Bug，先复现再定位。
say.note: Claude 会从复现步骤开始一步步来。

say.text: 用 5 Whys 分析这个报错的根本原因。
say.note: 它会连续追问五层原因，直达根因。

say.text: 帮我检查修复后是否引入回归，并补一个测试。
say.note: 按 Fix Verification 清单逐项核对。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through a 4-phase debugging process: reproduce, isolate, understand root cause, and verify the fix, checking for regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to debug a complex issue.

say_en.text: Debug this bug using the 4-phase method; reproduce first.
Use 5 Whys to find the root cause of this error.
say_en.note: It digs five layers down to the cause.

say_en.text: Check for regressions after the fix and add a test.
